text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

No problem at all, we are happy to help you next month. A basic bicycle service costs four hundred ninety nine rupees, and a puncture repair is one hundred twenty rupees, with any parts extra only after your approval. Which type of repair are you looking at?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?
A puncture repair is twelve hundred rupees, and any parts needed will be extra only after your approval. Which repair are you looking at?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
